summary: Agent run timeline draws one agent run as a Gantt chart: every model and tool step is a bar on a shared time axis, so people can see what ran in parallel, what took longest and where a step failed and was retried. While the run is live, a playhead sweeps across and the bars grow up to it.
use: When you need to see why an agent run was slow and which steps overlapped.
When a step failed and was retried, and people should see where in the run that happened.
When people care about cost per step as well as time.
In a run history or debugging view, to replay a finished run or follow one live.
features: Each step is a bar placed by its `start` and `duration` in seconds, with an optional `icon`, `color` and `cost`.
Pass `time` while the run is live. Bars grow up to it, a playhead sits on it, and the status line names the steps running at that moment.
Leave `time` out once the run is over. The tag turns from Running to Done and the status line reads "Finished in Ns" unless you set `status`.
`failed` hatches a bar red, and `note` is added to its tooltip, which also lists the step's duration and cost.
The footer counts up total time, cost, steps and retries as the playhead moves. Pass `stats` to show your own figures once the run is done.
The axis covers `span` seconds, defaulting to the end of the last step rounded up to a multiple of 4, with labels at quarters unless you pass `ticks`.
a11y: The run's state is written as text, Running or Done, and the spinner beside it is `aria-hidden`.
With `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`, the bars follow the playhead without easing and the status text changes without a crossfade.

faq.q: How do I follow a run live?
faq.a: Keep the steps you know about in `steps` and update `time` with the seconds since the run started, for example on each animation frame. When the run ends, leave `time` out.

faq.q: How do I show a failed step and its retry?
faq.a: Mark the failed step with `failed: true` and an optional `note`, like "2 tests failed", then add the retry as its own step after it. The footer counts the failed steps as retries.

faq.q: Can I replay a finished run?
faq.a: Yes. Pass the full `steps` list and move `time` from 0 to the end of the run. The demo plays it back at 1.6 times real speed.
